record.rationale: The native build loads packaged ICU data synchronously. Browser file import prepares the same immutable resources through the browser asset boundary before the shell runs.
responsibilities: Loads the five built-in ICU Dict resources through Vite URLs and shares the prepared native factory across Writer Markdown opens, with retry after a failed local asset request.

stackDivergence.rationale: Browser Vite assets supply the original bytes instead of the compiled native package address.

local.marker: imports Markdown through the native shell
